title: Mount Sinai & St. Catherine Monastery Tour - Witness the Sacred Sunrise
overview: Climb Mount Sinai under the stars and witness the breathtaking sunrise from the summit. Visit the historic St. Catherine's Monastery and explore its ancient relics, including the Burning Bush.

details.duration: 2 Hours (Monastery Visit) + Climb Time (~6 Hours Total)

itinerary: Pickup at 9:00 PM from Sharm El Sheikh hotel
3-hour drive to Catherine City (subject to convoy delays)
3-hour climb up Mount Sinai (7 km + 500 steps)
Rest at the summit and witness the sunrise
Descend back to St. Catherine's Monastery
Explore the monastery, Greek Orthodox chapel, and the Burning Bush
Return 3-hour drive to Sharm El Sheikh
highlights: Mount Sinai - The sacred mountain where Moses received the 10 Commandments
Sunrise View - A spectacular and unforgettable sunrise from the summit
St. Catherine Monastery - One of the oldest monasteries in the world
The Burning Bush - The legendary bush where God spoke to Moses
Greek Orthodox Chapel - Home to ancient icons and the Mosaic of Transfiguration
extra_tips: The climb is not too difficult - The path is well-trodden with many rest stops.
Camel rides are available for those who prefer a more relaxed journey.
Tailor-made private tours are available for large groups upon request.
recommendations: Bring a breakfast box for energy during the hike.
Wear warm clothes if visiting in winter.
Comfortable sport shoes or trainers are recommended.
